legacy_dashboard_install.title: {name} still registered as a Marketplace dashboard entry
legacy_dashboard_install.description:
{name} is still registered in the Marketplace as a **Dashboard** repository, as before it became an integration. The Marketplace downloads the integration's archive for it, so its installs and updates fail with "{error}". Uninstalling and installing it again does not help: the entry stays a Dashboard one.

1. In **Settings → Marketplace**, uninstall the {name} entry of type **Dashboard** if it is installed.
2. Open **Add from link** and remove {repositories} under **Added from links**.
3. Add `{url}` again with the type **Integration**, update it from there, then restart.

Your dashboards keep working: the integration serves the same cards.
